visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of stacked bamboo steamers. A hand wearing a black glove lifts the lid, revealing a variety of white and brown buns within a cloud of rising steam. The scene is warmly lit, focusing on the texture of the steamed dough and the traditional cooking method. (2) The shot transitions to a wide-angle view of a street-side shop with a dark wooden facade and a large black awning. A queue of customers stands on the sidewalk, with several motorcycles parked nearby. The daylight is bright and clear, indicating a busy afternoon at the storefront. (3) The scene cuts to the interior where a staff member in a white uniform and black gloves is seen packing freshly fried, sugar-coated donuts into paper bags. The camera then moves to extreme close-ups of various pastries being pulled apart by hand, showcasing the soft dough and rich fillings like black sesame, red bean, taro, chocolate, and pickled vegetables. (4) Final shots show a variety of the shop's signature products being held up against the shop's banner. Customers, including a young child, are seen interacting with the staff at the counter. The video ends with a low-angle shot of the shop's sign under a bright blue sky.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track opens with a male narrator speaking in a bright, high-pitched, and enthusiastic tone. He uses a fast speech rate with high pitch variability. An upbeat, acoustic guitar-driven BGM plays in the background, featuring a steady 4/4 rhythm and a tempo of approximately 120 BPM. Faint street noise creates a sense of place. (2) As the narration continues, distinct percussive sound effects are audible, specifically the rustling of plastic bags and the metallic clicking of tongs against a tray. The BGM remains consistent in volume, sitting comfortably behind the vocal track. The narrator's delivery is animated, with rising intonations to emphasize the food's appeal. (3) The acoustic texture shifts slightly with the addition of stylized tearing and crunching SFX, synchronized with the visual of pastries being opened. These sounds are crisp and have high spectral brightness. The ambient noise floor includes the low hum of traffic and an indistinct crowd murmur. (4) In the final phase, the narration concludes with a polite and inviting tone as the speaker provides location details. The music maintains its energetic folk-pop vibe until the very end, where it fades out smoothly. The overall mix is clean with a high signal-to-noise ratio.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote a multi-generational bao and donut shop in Qishan, Kaohsiung. By showcasing the steaming process, busy storefront, and close-up textures of various handmade fillings, it appeals to viewers' appetites and curiosity about traditional street food.
